breaking_news.headline: Poll: Most Americans have the summer blues about Trump and the economy

breaking_news.headline: Here is how SpaceX could turn up in your current investments
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX stock hit the market last week. Here's how it could turn up in your retirement or investment portfolio.

breaking_news.headline: Alan Greenspan, the legendary former Federal Reserve chair, dies
breaking_news.summary: During his chairmanship, Greenspan was celebrated as possibly the best central banker in history. But later, his reputation was tarnished by the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.

breaking_news.headline: Did you know? Alan Greenspan and Ayn Rand were close friends
breaking_news.summary: One of the most intellectually important relationships in the life of the late Fed chair Alan Greenspan was with his close friend, the formidable novelist and libertarian thinker Ayn Rand.

breaking_news.headline: When falling housing prices are good news — and when they're not
breaking_news.summary: Denver renters are celebrating falling housing costs. But sometimes cheaper housing is a sign of economic decline. How can you tell the difference?

breaking_news.headline: Is AI 'one big bubble'? Behind the tech sell-off
breaking_news.summary: Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment and whether it's "one big bubble."

breaking_news.headline: Congress passes the largest housing affordability bill in decades — and Trump cancels the signing
breaking_news.summary: President Trump canceled a signing ceremony for the bill Wednesday, saying Congress must first pass a strict voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: Key figure in South Africa police corruption scandal pleads guilty
breaking_news.summary: Prosecutors say Vusimusi "Cat" Matlala could provide evidence against "high-ranking officials".

breaking_news.headline: Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, after tension with Republicans
breaking_news.summary: But the budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with some members of his own party over the issue.

breaking_news.headline: Europe's heatwave shifts east as France raises health alert to highest level
breaking_news.summary: Temperatures in Germany could hit 40C in some areas while French officials say deaths linked to the heat are being seen among young people.

breaking_news.headline: Quake is devastating blow to Venezuela at time of uncertainty
breaking_news.summary: The quake comes less than six months after Venezuela's then-leader Nicolás Maduro was seized by US forces.

breaking_news.headline: 'I thought I was going to die' - Venezuelans describe earthquake panic
breaking_news.summary: Buildings were flattened in the capital Caracas, where voices have been heard calling from the rubble.

breaking_news.headline: IBM hails new 'block of flats' design breakthrough for ultra tiny chips
breaking_news.summary: IBM says it has created the world's first known chip tech below 1 nanometre - but it will be some time before it's ready for production.

breaking_news.headline: Price cuts on family summer days out come into force
breaking_news.summary: The government is reducing VAT from 20% to 5% on attractions and kids' meals  as schools begin to break-up.

breaking_news.headline: The legal fight to get equal pay for Germany's disabled workers
breaking_news.summary: A test case is seeking the minimum wage for 300,000 disabled people who currently get paid less.

breaking_news.headline: I've spent 30 years in recruitment - this is how to get a job

breaking_news.headline: How you can save money on your energy bill as debts rise
breaking_news.summary: Experts say support is available as total debt and arrears to suppliers hit a new record.
